text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Phew!
Trainer, that time just now
was pretty great, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Surrounding Students
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh...!"
"As expected of Almond Eye..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
For this problem... substitute 3 for x—
and then y is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"—How does this look,
Teacher?"

text_block_list.name: Math Teacher
text_block_list.text: Correct! Brilliant as always, Ai-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye lived a truly fulfilling academy life
every single day. However, one day—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*. Seriously—what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
......
...Huh? Did I say that out loud?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, it's nothing.
Don't worry about it.
choice_data_list: If something's bothering you, I'm here to listen.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, really, I'm fine!
Thanks for the training today, too.
See you later!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Leaving only those words, Almond Eye walked out.
choice_data_list: (Well, if she doesn't want to talk about it—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, after that... I frequently saw Almond Eye consulting students with a serious expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~~... I see. Now that is
what you call a serious problem.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'd be glad to help!
Leave it all to Machi-chan!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...I knew that's what you'd say, Tannhauser-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: With things like that, it's also important to leave it a bit rough. You could say being too particular isn't good either.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I suppose... that's the real question...
Which path should I choose to find true satisfaction?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What you told me, Ms. Akebono...
I tried it yesterday. I feel like
I'm finally starting to see the light.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yay~☆
I'm rooting for you, Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At this point, it's obvious that Almond Eye
is seriously troubled by something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had intentionally avoided getting too deeply involved...
but I believe stepping in and taking it all on is also a Trainer's duty.
choice_data_list: (...No matter how heavy her worries might be...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on that day—Almond Eye quietly gazed outside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, Almond Eye began
speaking of her own accord. Finally—
the cause of her troubles would come to light.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I agonized over it so much, but...
I guess this is the only answer in the end.
............

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The new hamburger steak recipe for the bento will be...
a high-protein burger made of lean meat and tofu!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well yeah, I did consult
some of the other students.
The ones who are known to be good cooks.
choice_data_list: So... you were just agonizing over a bento recipe?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...That is true, but.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey!
What are you laughing so much for!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's something we eat every day, you know?
Of course I'm going to be particular about it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I calculate both the calories and protein score
when I cook! I'm taking this seriously!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. It turned out so delicious, so I was thinking of letting you try some, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I won't, then.
Not for a mean person who makes fun of bento.
choice_data_list: ...Indeed, food is the source of strength.
...True, good food really is the source of our strength.
To think they went to such elaborate lengths with the food.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I won't, then.
Not for a mean person who makes fun of bento.
choice_data_list: ...Indeed, food is the source of strength.
...True, good food really is the source of our strength.
To think they went to such elaborate lengths with the food.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Isn't that the most crucial part for an athlete?
Good grief, really—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Have you reflected on what you did?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Very well. ...In that case, I will make and bring a hamburg steak for you tomorrow as well.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Since I went through the trouble
of making lunch myself, after all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I research every day to make sure the taste rivals the cafeteria food.
For you to laugh at that—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! I can't let this slide.
I'll have you taste it yourself to see
just how much care I put into my bento!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it—it was a reminder that
even those who seem perfect can worry over
completely ordinary things, after all.
